notes.title: AETHUS Joins CULT Games
notes.content:
Right - exciting news: Pawsmonaut Games has officially joined forces with us lot at CULT Games to publish [b]AETHUS[/b].

If you haven’t yet, please wishlist AETHUS on Steam and maybe have a wee play the demo:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2541530/AETHUS/

And take a look at the new AETHUS trailer:

https://youtu.be/uszrU89pgmc

This means more support for Alex, the mastermind behind the game, to keep building AETHUS exactly as it should be: story-rich, anti-corporate and zero compromise. Just a damn good survival game made properly, start to finish, by an exceptional solo developer (and their excellent canine companion, Apollo - the beautiful dalmatian on Pawmonaut's logo.)

More updates soon - in Maeve's words: we’re just getting started.

Sarah @ CULT Games

notes.title: Welcome to the Awaysis
notes.content:
[p]WELCOME ADVENTURERS!  
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651695/77827651ef439cb154d85fcc85ca1798f5f02f01.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled to have just announced our brand new game, Awaysis! A totally revolutionary take on the dungeon-brawler genre that takes a ragtag bunch of heroes on the adventure of a lifetime as they skid, slide and glide to victory. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651695/71161feb8c6d25b232c604a8612d0b82b4975fd1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Awaysis is an ancient floating relic in the sky, whose origins predate known history. When thousands of years of harmony is broken by forces of terrible darkness, the Awaysis finds itself under attack and the fate of the world below sits on a knife’s edge.   
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651695/fa9c30592f875b99b530230d47b361fdea68fa6d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]To restore balance to the world, you’ll have to master momentum and mayhem to traverse through the world and defeat any enemy that stands in the way.  With a cutting-edge blend of reactive physics, backed up by arcade-tight controls, you won’t be crawling through these dungeons!  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651695/a04c1dc976db35abeefd6f30dd4da5d8b9ea1cc6.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Great treasures await those brave enough to venture forth and unearth them, will you step-up to claim them?![/p]
